name: AllWallst Market Widgets for TradingView
author: allwallst

sections.description:
AllWallst Market Widgets for TradingView allows financial bloggers, crypto news sites, and investors to embed interactive stock, cryptocurrency, and forex widgets into any WordPress page, post, or sidebar.

Features

  • Zero Exchange Fees: Embed institutional-grade charts without paying expensive market data licensing fees.
  • Scrolling Ticker Tape: Add live market updates for US equities, crypto pairs, and major currencies ([allwallst_mw_ticker_tape]).
  • Mini Sparklines & Symbol Overview: Responsive interactive mini charts for single assets ([allwallst_mw_mini_chart], [allwallst_mw_symbol_overview]).
  • Auto Dark/Light Mode Sync: Automatically matches your visitor’s operating system or website theme skin.
  • Visual Shortcode Builder: Preview and generate customized shortcodes with real-time feedback inside your WordPress dashboard.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Embeds load asynchronously directly in the visitor’s browser without slowing down your WordPress database.

Supported Markets

  • US Stocks & Indices: NASDAQ, NYSE, S&P 500, Dow Jones (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL, NYSE:TSLA, NASDAQ:NVDA)
  • Cryptocurrency: Binance, Coinbase, Bybit (e.g., BINANCE:BTCUSDT, BINANCE:ETHUSDT)
  • Forex: Major and minor FX currency pairs (e.g., FX:EURUSD, FX:GBPUSD)

Pro Features Available at AllWallst.com

  • S&P 500 and Nasdaq Sector Heatmaps
  • Crypto Market Heatmap
  • Stock & Crypto Screener Tables
  • Technical Analysis Meter Gauge (Strong Buy / Strong Sell)
  • Full Candlestick Charts with Indicators & Drawing Tools
  • Broker Affiliate CTA Bars (Monetize charts with eToro, Binance, or broker referral links)
  • Site-Wide Sticky Header/Footer Tickers
  • Dynamic Post Symbols (ACF & Custom Field support)

External services

This plugin relies on external 3rd-party services to render financial charts and ticker widgets:

  • TradingView Embeds (TradingView Inc.)

    • Service URL: https://s3.tradingview.com/
    • Purpose: Powers real-time interactive stock, cryptocurrency, and forex charts, mini sparklines, and scrolling ticker tapes embedded on your WordPress website.
    • What data is sent and when: When a visitor loads a page containing an embedded widget, their browser sends a standard HTTP GET request directly to TradingView’s Amazon S3 CDN to fetch the widget embed scripts. Standard web request metadata (visitor IP address, browser User-Agent header, and the referring page URL) is transmitted to TradingView as part of the connection. No user credentials, database records, or personal WordPress site data are transmitted.
    • Terms of Use: https://www.tradingview.com/policies/
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.tradingview.com/privacy-policy/

  • Freemius (Freemius, Inc.)

    • Service URL: https://freemius.com/
    • Purpose: Provides optional opt-in telemetry, security updates, and licensing management for pro upgrades.
    • What data is sent and when: If the site administrator explicitly opts in during plugin activation, basic site technical data (WordPress version, site URL, active theme, and administrator email) is securely sent to Freemius. If the administrator skips the opt-in screen, no data is sent.
    • Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
    • Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

sections.installation:
1. Upload the allwallst-market-widgets-tradingview folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly via the WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Market Widgets > Shortcode Generator & Help in your admin menu to build your first widget.
  4. Paste the generated shortcode (e.g. [allwallst_mw_ticker_tape]) into any post, page, or widget area.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid TradingView account?

No. AllWallst Market Widgets uses TradingView’s free embed system. You do not need an account or API key.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The widgets render asynchronously via client-side JavaScript straight from TradingView’s global CDN.

How do I enter symbol names?

Always prefix the ticker with the exchange name, for example: NASDAQ:AAPL, BINANCE:BTCUSDT, or FX:EURUSD.

Is this plugin affiliated with TradingView?

No. AllWallst Market Widgets for TradingView is an independent WordPress integration created by AllWallst.com and is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by TradingView Inc.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2

  • Updated WordPress compatibility: Tested up to 7.1.
  • Removed legacy shortcode aliases (mw_*) to comply with WordPress.org minimum 4-character prefix requirements. All shortcodes now exclusively use allwallst_mw_*.
  • Added guard check for Freemius SDK loading to prevent duplicate library inclusion.

1.3.1

  • Renamed plugin and updated slug to AllWallst Market Widgets for TradingView to comply with WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Migrated widget script loading to standard wp_enqueue_script hooks (removed inline script tags).
  • Scoped admin generator scripts strictly to plugin admin pages.
  • Added comprehensive External Services documentation for TradingView and Freemius in readme.txt.
  • Prefixed all functions, classes, and shortcodes with unique 4+ character identifier (allwallst_mw_).
  • Verified clean activation under WP_DEBUG = true.

1.3.0

  • Added Auto Dark/Light mode synchronization.
  • Added real-time interactive preview inside the admin Shortcode Generator.
  • Added comprehensive legal liability and data disclaimers.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
